run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to load preprocessed_builds.yaml and print modified build entries as YAML
review_gen_build_yaml: review the script that mutates build entries with private build, c language, and insecure flags
refactor_gen_build_yaml: refactor the script to accept a custom YAML input path via command-line arguments

test_gen_build_yaml: test the script by providing a sample preprocessed_builds.yaml and verifying the output YAML structure
